_comment: Template — 6 beats: hook / problem / build / demo / result / CTA. Copy to a real episode folder and fill in.

cues.text: HOOK — name the exact pain, in the viewer's own words.
PROBLEM — why this manual process actually costs time/money/errors.
THE BUILD — what tool/agent you used and the core logic, plainly.
DEMO WALKTHROUGH — narrate the screen recording as it plays, beat by beat.
RESULT — the specific before-to-after number. Say the number out loud.
CTA — the one specific next step, stated clearly, once.
